headline: UEFA member nations call FIFA's international break a 'disaster'
description: European soccer federations told UEFA they are not happy with the new extended four-game blocks of international matches that finished this week.

headline: Man City charges LIVE reaction: Latest updates as Arteta, Carrick, Iraola, Maresca speak
description: The Premier League is back for its first weekend of fixtures since Manchester City were found guilty of breaching its financial rules, a verdict they are appealing.

headline: Enzo Maresca: Man City titles not tainted by guilty verdict
description: Enzo Maresca has said he would still have joined Manchester City as manager if he had known the club had been found guilty of breaching financial rules.

headline: Vincent Kompany 'proud' of Man City achievements despite guilty verdict over Premier League breaches
description: Former Manchester City captain Vincent Kompany said he remains "proud" of the club's achievements during his time there despite the club being found guilty of more than 100 breaches of Premier League financial rules.
